title: Cardmember Days on a Finch Circle Courtesy Reissue — Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Note
content:
**Note.** For a courtesy reissue of a Finch Note in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the courtesy card days are 7 when the customer holds an active Marlowe & Finch card account and a Marlowe & Finch purchase was charged to a Marlowe & Finch card within the last 3 whole months, 3 when the customer holds an active card account and no such purchase was charged, and 0 when the customer holds no active card account.

The card accounts and their status, and the card purchases at Marlowe & Finch among the account transactions, are read from the customer's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts.

| Active Marlowe & Finch card account held | Marlowe & Finch purchase charged to a Marlowe & Finch card within the last 3 whole months | Courtesy card days |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 7 |
| yes | no | 3 |
| no | any | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An active Store Card used at a Marlowe & Finch store six weeks before the request: 7.
- An active Mastercard used only at supermarkets in that time: 3.
- The only card account is closed: 0.
